title: RFC 9580 OpenPGP decoded packet stream (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED. Not part of RFC 9580: RFC 9580 defines a binary packet format in prose, field lists and tables and publishes no schema. This JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) describes a DECODED packet stream: an array of packets, each a header and a body, with octet strings as lowercase hex. Every definition carries x-derived: true, x-source (section), x-verbatim (region ids in the *.verbatim.txt files of this directory) and, where a requirement constrains it, x-requirements (rfc-9580#R-NNNN). Rules JSON Schema cannot express (lengths that must agree, MPI bit counts, OPS/Signature correspondence, packet-sequence grammar) are checked by validate.derived.py. Registry enums admit registered and private-use values only.

hex.description: An octet string, lowercase hex, two digits per octet.

time.description: Time field: unsigned 4-octet count of seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

mpi.description: Multiprecision integer: 2-octet bit count then ((bits + 7) / 8) octets, big-endian. `value` is the octets after the bit count. Not expressible here, checked by validate.derived.py: len(value) == (bits+7)//8, the top octet has no bits above `bits` (unused bits zero, R-0004), and in v6 Key, Signature and PKESK packets bits equals the position of the most significant non-zero bit (R-0003).

curve_oid.description: Curve OID field of ECDSA, EdDSALegacy and ECDH keys and of the ECDH KDF Param: a 1-octet size (0 and 0xFF reserved for future extensions) then the DER OID body without tag and length octets.

oneOf.title: Salted S2K
oneOf.x-generate: Only when string is high entropy

partial_length.description: A Partial Body Length: 1 << (octet & 0x1F), a power of 2 from 1 to 2^30.

oneOf.description: Partial Body Lengths: one or more partial headers then a final 1-, 2- or 5-octet length header (which may be zero). The first partial length MUST be at least 512 octets; the last length header MUST NOT be partial (structural here: `final` is never partial).
Legacy indeterminate length: the packet runs to the end of the input. MUST NOT be generated; MAY be interpreted.

header.description: Packet header. First octet: bit 7 always one; bit 6 one = OpenPGP format (bits 5-0 Type ID), zero = Legacy format (bits 5-2 Type ID, bits 1-0 length-type). Legacy headers can only encode Type IDs below 16. Type ID 0 is Reserved and MUST NOT be used. Partial Body Lengths only for data packets (literal, compressed, encrypted: read here as Type IDs 8, 9, 11, 18; derived).

oneOf.description: Simple S2K: octet 0 = 0x00, octet 1 = hash algorithm. MUST NOT be generated (R-0011).
Iterated and Salted S2K: 0x03, hash, 8-octet salt, 1-octet coded count c; octets hashed = (16 + (c & 15)) << ((c >> 4) + 6).

Argon2: 0x04, 16-octet salt, passes t, parallelism p, encoded_m (memory 2^encoded_m KiB). t and p MUST be non-zero; encoded_m MUST be from 3+ceil(log_2(p)) to 31 (rendered as if/then per p range). Argon2id, version 0x13.
Private or Experimental S2K type; its field size is not specified (Table 1: '-').

ecdh_kdf_params.description: ECDH KDF parameters: 1-octet size of the following fields (0 and 0xFF reserved), a 1-octet value 1 reserved for future extensions, KDF hash ID, key-wrap symmetric algorithm ID. MD5, SHA-1 and RIPEMD-160 MUST NOT be used in an ECDH KDF (R-0302; producer rule, not enforced here).

secret_material_1.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 1. p < q; u = p^-1 mod q (not checked here).

secret_material_2.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 2.

secret_material_3.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 3.

secret_material_16.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 16.

secret_material_17.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 17.

secret_material_19.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 19.

public_material_22.description: Public key material for algorithm 22. The only curve defined for EdDSALegacy is Ed25519Legacy (§5.5.5.5).

secret_material_22.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 22.

secret_material_18.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 18. Curve25519Legacy: big-endian MPI, bits always 255 (wire 00 FF ...), integer divisible by 8, >= 2^254, < 2^255 (R-0199..R-0202, checked by validate.derived.py).

secret_material_25.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 25.

secret_material_26.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 26.

secret_material_27.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 27.

secret_material_28.description: Cleartext secret key material for algorithm 28.

public_key_v3.description: Version 3 (and identical version 2) Public Key / Public Subkey fields: version, creation time, 2-octet validity in days (0 = no expiry), algorithm, RSA n and e. Version 2 and 3 keys MUST NOT be generated; MAY be accepted.

public_key_v4.description: Version 4 Public Key / Public Subkey fields. SHOULD NOT be generated but SHOULD be accepted.

public_key_v6.description: Version 6 Public Key / Public Subkey fields, with the 4-octet octet count of the public key material (equality with the encoded material length is checked by validate.derived.py). The deprecated Ed25519Legacy and Curve25519Legacy OIDs MUST NOT be accepted in version 6 key material.

secret_fields_v3.description: Secret key fields appended to a version 3 public key (v3 applies to v2 too where v=3). Usage 0: cleartext material plus 2-octet checksum. 253 (AEAD) / 254 (CFB) / 255 (MalleableCFB): symmetric algorithm, [AEAD algorithm], S2K specifier, IV or nonce, encrypted material (AEAD: tag split out as aead_tag; CFB: SHA-1 inside the ciphertext; MalleableCFB and LegacyCFB: 2-octet checksum inside the ciphertext). Any other non-zero usage is a symmetric algorithm ID with MD5-derived key (LegacyCFB): IV then encrypted material. Argon2 only with usage 253. The IV length for CFB equals the cipher block size (not tabulated in RFC 9580; checked by validate.derived.py with inferred sizes).

secret_fields_v4.description: Secret key fields appended to a version 4 public key (v4 applies to v2 too where v=3). Usage 0: cleartext material plus 2-octet checksum. 253 (AEAD) / 254 (CFB) / 255 (MalleableCFB): symmetric algorithm, [AEAD algorithm], S2K specifier, IV or nonce, encrypted material (AEAD: tag split out as aead_tag; CFB: SHA-1 inside the ciphertext; MalleableCFB and LegacyCFB: 2-octet checksum inside the ciphertext). Any other non-zero usage is a symmetric algorithm ID with MD5-derived key (LegacyCFB): IV then encrypted material. Argon2 only with usage 253. The IV length for CFB equals the cipher block size (not tabulated in RFC 9580; checked by validate.derived.py with inferred sizes).

secret_fields_v6.description: Secret key fields appended to a version 6 public key (v6 applies to v2 too where v=3). Usage 0: cleartext material, no checksum. 253 (AEAD) / 254 (CFB) / 255 (MalleableCFB): symmetric algorithm, [AEAD algorithm], S2K-specifier length, S2K specifier, IV or nonce, encrypted material (AEAD: tag split out as aead_tag; CFB: SHA-1 inside the ciphertext; MalleableCFB and LegacyCFB: 2-octet checksum inside the ciphertext). Any other non-zero usage is a symmetric algorithm ID with MD5-derived key (LegacyCFB): IV then encrypted material. Version 6: params_length counts all following S2K parameter fields; usage 255 and LegacyCFB MUST be rejected. Argon2 only with usage 253. The IV length for CFB equals the cipher block size (not tabulated in RFC 9580; checked by validate.derived.py with inferred sizes).

public_key_packet.description: Body of Public Key (6) and Public Subkey (14) packets.

secret_key_packet.description: Body of Secret Key (5) and Secret Subkey (7) packets: the public fields plus `secret`.

pkesk_v3.description: Version 3 PKESK: version 3, 8-octet Key ID (all zeros = anonymous recipient), algorithm, encrypted session key fields. RSA: MPI m^e mod n. Elgamal: MPIs g^k mod p, m*y^k mod p. ECDH: MPI ephemeral point, 1-octet size (255 reserved), wrapped key. X25519 / X448: 32 / 56-octet ephemeral key, 1-octet size of the following fields, the cleartext symmetric algorithm ID (MUST be AES-128, -192 or -256), wrapped key. Precedes a v1 SEIPD (or historic SED) only.

pkesk_v6.description: Version 6 PKESK: version 6, 1-octet size of the next two fields (0 = anonymous recipient: both omitted), key version, fingerprint (20 octets for v4, 32 for v6 keys), algorithm, encrypted session key fields (no symmetric algorithm ID). Only key versions 4 and 6 have defined fingerprint lengths, so key_info_length is 0, 21 or 33 (derived). Precedes a v2 SEIPD only. Elgamal v6 PKESK MUST NOT be generated.

then.description: 4-octet time field: when the signature was made. MUST be present in the hashed area.
4-octet time field: seconds after creation that the signature expires; absent or 0 = never.
1 octet: 0 not exportable, 1 exportable; absent = exportable.
1-octet level (depth), 1-octet trust amount (<120 partial, >=120 complete).
Null-terminated UTF-8 Regular Expression (§8 syntax). The terminating zero octet MUST be present (else reject the subpacket) and is removed in `regex`.
1 octet: 0 not revocable, 1 revocable; absent = revocable.
4-octet time field: key validity in seconds after key creation; absent or 0 = never expires.
Array of 1-octet symmetric algorithm IDs, most preferred first.
Deprecated. 1-octet class (bit 0x80 must be set; 0x40 = sensitive), 1-octet algorithm, 20-octet v4 fingerprint. MUST NOT be generated.
8-octet Key ID of the issuer. MUST NOT be included when the issuing key's version is greater than 4 (producer rule).

4 octets of flags (only 0x80000000 human-readable defined; all undefined flags MUST be zero), 2-octet name length M, 2-octet value length N, M octets of UTF-8 name, N octets of value. Names: IETF namespace (no '@') or tag@domain (tag MUST NOT contain '@'); the pattern allows at most one '@' (derived).
Array of 1-octet hash algorithm IDs, ordered.
Array of 1-octet compression algorithm IDs, ordered; zero or absence = uncompressed preferred.
N octets of flags; only 0x80 (No-modify) of the first octet defined; undefined flags MUST be zero.
String: URI of the preferred key server.
1 octet, Boolean: whether this User ID (or User Attribute) is primary; absent = zero. The source does not say which non-zero values mean true (README finding).
String: URI of the signature policy.
N octets of flags (Table 9); an implementation MUST NOT assume a fixed size; missing octets are zero.
String: the User ID responsible for the signing.
1-octet revocation code (Table 10), N octets of UTF-8 reason (may be empty).
N octets of flags (Table 11: 0x01 v1 SEIPD, 0x08 v2 SEIPD in the first octet).
1-octet public key algorithm, 1-octet hash algorithm, N octets of hash; N MUST be the digest size of the hash (digest sizes inferred from algorithm names, SHA-1 = 20 stated).
One complete Signature packet body.

1-octet key version, N octets of fingerprint (20 for v4, 32 for v6). The version octet MUST match the signature version (enforced in the v4 and v6 signature definitions); if not, the signature is malformed.
1-octet key version, N octets of fingerprint of the intended recipient primary key (20 for v4, 32 for v6).
Array of pairs of octets (symmetric algorithm, AEAD algorithm), most preferred first; AES-128 + OCB implicitly last if absent.

subpacket.description: Signature subpacket: encoded length (1, 2 or 5 octets; covers type octet and data), type octet (bit 7 = critical, bits 6-0 = Subpacket Type ID), data. `value` is the decoded body for known types; `body` is raw data for placeholder (10) and private (100-110) types. A critical unknown subpacket SHOULD make the signature be considered in error (not malformed packet structure; validate.derived.py reports it).

signature_v3.description: Version 3 Signature: version 3, 1-octet hashed length (MUST be 5), signature type, creation time, 8-octet issuer Key ID, algorithm, hash, left 16 bits of the hash, algorithm-specific MPIs (RSA m^d mod n; DSA r, s). v3 signatures MUST NOT be created, MAY be accepted. v3 MUST NOT be used with ECDSA, EdDSALegacy, Ed25519 or Ed448 (pk_algo restricted to the RSA, Elgamal and DSA IDs; derived). v3 Standalone (0x02) signatures MUST be ignored (excluded).

signature_v4.description: Version 4 Signature: version 4, type, algorithm, hash, 2-octet hashed subpacket length, hashed subpackets, 2-octet unhashed length, unhashed subpackets, left 16 bits of the hash, algorithm-specific fields. The hashed area MUST contain a Signature Creation Time subpacket. An Issuer Fingerprint subpacket's version MUST be 4. Ed25519 needs a >= 256-bit hash, Ed448 a >= 512-bit hash.

signature_v6.description: Version 6 Signature: as version 4 but with 4-octet subpacket-area lengths, and after the left 16 bits a 1-octet salt size that MUST match Table 23 for the hash algorithm, then the salt. Ed25519Legacy (EdDSALegacy) MUST NOT be used. Hash algorithms without a v6 salt size (MD5, SHA-1, RIPEMD-160) cannot appear (derived from Table 23 'N/A').

skesk_v4.description: Version 4 SKESK: version 4, symmetric algorithm, S2K specifier, optional encrypted session key (CFB, all-zero IV; decrypts to algorithm ID + session key). When the encrypted session key is present the S2K MUST use a salt (Simple S2K excluded).

skesk_v6.description: Version 6 SKESK: version 6, 1-octet count of the next 5 fields, symmetric algorithm, AEAD algorithm, 1-octet S2K length, S2K specifier, IV (AEAD nonce length), encrypted session key, 16-octet AEAD tag.

ops_v3.description: Version 3 One-Pass Signature (used with v3 and v4 signatures): version, type, hash, algorithm, 8-octet Key ID, nested flag (0 = next packet is another OPS over the same data).

ops_v6.description: Version 6 One-Pass Signature: version, type, hash, algorithm, salt size (MUST match Table 23), salt (MUST match the corresponding Signature, checked by validate.derived.py), 32-octet signer fingerprint, nested flag.

compressed.description: Compressed Data: 1-octet algorithm, compressed data (ZIP = raw DEFLATE, ZLIB, BZip2). `packets` is the decompressed content when decoded; it MUST be an OpenPGP Message (checked by validate.derived.py).

sed.description: Symmetrically Encrypted Data (obsolete): CFB-encrypted random prefix (block size + 2) then CFB data after resynchronization. MUST NOT be created.

marker.description: Marker: the three octets 0x50 0x47 0x50 ('PGP'). MUST be ignored when received.

literal.description: Literal Data: 1-octet format (b binary, u UTF-8 text; t, l and '1' deprecated), 1-octet file name length then the name (at most 255 octets), 4-octet date, literal data.

user_id.description: User ID: UTF-8 text, conventionally an RFC 2822 name-addr; no restrictions.

image_attribute.description: Image Attribute: 2-octet LITTLE-ENDIAN image header length (16 for version 1), header version 1, encoding format, 12 reserved octets that MUST be 0, then the image.

user_attribute.description: User Attribute: one or more subpackets, each with a 1-, 2- or 5-octet length, a 1-octet type and data.

seipd_v1.description: v1 SEIPD: version 1, CFB ciphertext (IV zero) of random prefix + 2 repeated octets + plaintext + 0xD3 0x14 + SHA-1 MDC. `packets`, when decrypted, MUST be an OpenPGP Message.

seipd_v2.description: v2 SEIPD: version 2, cipher, AEAD algorithm, chunk size octet c (chunk = 1 << (c + 6); MUST accept 0..16, MUST NOT create > 16), 32-octet salt, chunks each followed by its tag, final 16-octet tag. `packets`, when decrypted, MUST be an Optionally Padded Message.

padding.description: Padding: random octets. MUST be ignored when received.

opaque.description: Body of a non-critical unassigned (40-59) or private (60-63) packet: ignored.

packet.description: One decoded packet. The body definition is selected by header.type_id (Table 3). Critical Type IDs with no definition (0, 15, 16, 19, 20, 22-39) fail validation: an unknown critical packet invalidates the whole sequence. Non-critical 40-63 are accepted as opaque.
